en.title: References
en.description: An extension that shows references in bible verses.
en.no-references: No cross references for this verse.
en.references-unavailable: Could not load the references for this verse.
en.download-body: Keep every cross-reference on your device so they still open when you have no connection. The download carries on in the background.
en.download-body-with-translation: Keep every cross-reference on your device, along with {{name}}, so they still open when you have no connection. The download carries on in the background.
en.download-done-with-translation: Cross-references and {{name}} are now available offline
en.download-partial: Saved {{downloaded}} of {{total}} chapters. {{failed}} couldn't be downloaded.
en.download-translation-failed: Saved the cross-references, but {{name}} couldn't be downloaded.
en.download-failed: Couldn't download the cross-references. Check your connection and try again.
